description: Conventional pipelines with no model-driven orchestration. They use the same Stage 2 scoring and independent-verification code, the same inputs, the same pinned checksum and the same acceptance rubric as PRSWeave. Two variants are pre-registered so that the comparison does not rest on a deliberately weak baseline.

steps: fetch score metadata and source-GWAS trait (same cached evidence tools)
phenotype rule: the requested skeletal site must equal the score's site (same deterministic site extractor as the Population Context specialist); otherwise ABSTAINED
read genotypes with the Stage 2 strict reader; any error -> FAILED (no repair)
verify with Stage 2 independent scorer (tol 1e-9) plus output checksum; disagreement -> re-run scoring once, re-verify; still failing -> FAILED

as baseline_strict, except genotypes are read by header name: if every required column is present exactly once, the table is reordered to the canonical layout (the same deterministic repair tool PRSWeave can call), and the reordered file is verified cell-for-cell before scoring

not_included: Neither baseline searches for alternative scores or requests human review; both abstain on phenotype mismatch.
